tagline: Sunrise, coffee, and recovery on the sand

whatItIs.heading: What it is
whatItIs.body: Alva is an early-morning beach setup for the sunrise fitness and paddle crowd. Finish your workout and drop into a free chair on the sand — no reservation, no rush. We'll have coffee and fresh coconuts waiting so you can recover before the city wakes up.

whenWhere.heading: When & where
whenWhere.route: Sunrise at Copacabana → late morning at Ipanema

follow.heading: Follow along
follow.body: See where we set up next, sunrise photos, and schedule updates.
